map.两端开口管 f₁ = v/2L，含全部谐波。: A pipe open at both ends has f1 = v/2L and contains all harmonics.

map.📚 深度解析：开管驻波频率: 📚 Deep Dive: Standing-wave frequencies in an open pipe

map.计算开管基频与全部整数泛音。: Compute the open-pipe fundamental and all integer harmonics.

map.管长 L=0.66 m、声速 c=343 m/s，基频 f1=c/(2L)=34: With pipe length L=0.66 m and sound speed c=343 m/s, the fundamental f1=c/(2L)=343/1.32=260 Hz; harmonics are 2f1, 3f1... (integer multiples).
map.开管与闭管音色为何不同？: Why do open and closed pipes sound different?
map.开管含全部整数谐波、闭管仅奇次，谐波结构不同导致音色差异。: An open pipe contains all integer harmonics while a closed pipe has only odd ones, so the differing harmonic structure changes the timbre.
map.实际管口需要修正吗？: Does a real pipe mouth need correction?
map.真实开口端略外延（端部修正），有效长度略大于几何长度，精密计算需加上修正量。: A real open end extends slightly beyond the pipe (end correction), so the effective length is a bit longer than the geometric one and precision work must add that correction.
